comments.text: "The last ice age" is a misnomer. We are STILL in the current ice age, which began roughly 2.6 million years ago after the uplifting of the Panama isthmus stopped Pacific water from flowing into the Atlantic. During this time, Earth has seen repeated glacial periods alternating with warm interglacial periods. What ended about 12,000 years ago was the most recent glacial period, and we are in an interglacial period now... and this one is not even the warmest. The planet will likely cycle back into another glacial period in 40,000 to 100,000 years, not that any of us will be around to see it.
